# Improved Critical (`features:champion-improved-critical`)
**Class:** [Fighter](../classes/fighter.md) | **Subclass:** [Champion](../subclasses/champion.md) | **Level:** [Fighter 3](../levels/fighter-3.md)

Your attack rolls with weapons and Unarmed Strikes can score a Critical Hit on a roll of 19 or 20 on the d20.
